title: B1_147

finding: Ignited very quickly; flow was turned off after the flame spread halfway; the flame extinguished quickly and was sooty with a blue leading edge.

sourceLabel: Burning and Suppression of Solids-II (BASS-II) Final Report, Table A.1

title: SAFFIRE-I_I-1
condition: microgravity · concurrent flow · airflow 20 cm/s · 40.6 × 94 cm sample · 0.37 mm thick
finding: NASA reports that the concurrent flame reached a steady spread behavior after the ignition transient. The spread rate and flame power are aggregate report values, not a time series.
sourceLabel: Saffire: A Novel Approach to Study of Spacecraft Fire Safety Using Un-manned Spacecraft, Table 1
provenance: NASA NTRS report 20180005168, Table 1 and slides 24 and 30. Airflow, sample, oxygen, spread-rate, burn-duration, and burn-length values are reported for sample I-1. Table 1 reports 420 s; an earlier result slide rounds the burn to 400 s. Flame power is reported as 1200 ± 300 W for the Saffire-I large SIBAL burn; it is not a sensor time series.

title: SAFFIRE-I_I-2
condition: microgravity · opposed flow · airflow 20 cm/s · 40.6 × 94 cm sample · 0.37 mm thick
finding: NASA reports an approximately 10 cm burn length and 1.3 mm/s microgravity spread rate for the opposed-flow test. These are aggregate results, not a time series.
sourceLabel: Saffire: A Novel Approach to Study of Spacecraft Fire Safety Using Un-manned Spacecraft, Table 1
provenance: NASA NTRS report 20180005168, slides 29–30. The report gives approximate oxygen condition and aggregate spread/burn values; separate initial and final oxygen readings and flame-power values are not supplied for I-2.
